title: Fix fragmentation parameter cross-reference in SCHC draft
description: Correctness review found draft-lichen-schc-lora-00 §5.4 says the fragmentation parameters cross-reference spec/03-adaptation.md Section 5.7, but 5.7 is Rule Versioning; the fixed fragmentation profile is Section 5.6. Correct the reference so implementers land on the normative M/N/tile/RCS limits.
